entries.logic: Implements a VBox-based sidebar with full-width buttons, separators, and a bottom-aligned version info via VGrow spacer.
entries.implementation: VBox spacer = new VBox(); VBox.setVgrow(spacer, Priority.ALWAYS); getChildren().add(spacer);
entries.rationale: Maximized space utility and clear hierarchical navigation, following the Parcel 2.0 design system.
